company_name: China Chunlai Education Group Co., Ltd.

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: H1 FY2026 interim EPS note, weighted shares for diluted EPS 1,231,391,842 (1,200m basic + Pre-IPO share options). Held FLAT: SBC (~0.15% of revenue) is expensed in the flows. No buybacks ever (ShareRepurchases 0 FY2017-H1 FY2026), so the flat count is a modelling convention the company does not fund.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Equity-settled share-based payments' RMB3,288k (1969.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:8133); no net-share-settlement taxes (EquityAwardTaxes 0 all periods).
inputs.fx_note: Model flows in CNY (RMB, the statements' currency); HKEX quote in HKD. fx_rate = 1.1724 HKD per CNY (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, regularMarketTime 2026-10-16). Cross-check: Yahoo HKDCNY=X 0.8521 -> 1/0.8521 = 1.1736, a 0.1% tie that confirms direction (CNY -> HKD multiplies). No dual listing to parity-check against; the H-share is the only line. refresh_price.py does not move this rate - refresh it by hand on a later price update.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T03:37:47Z (HKEX intraday, last trade before the midday break on a 16k-share day; thin, should be replaced at the next regular close)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY. Risk-free: China 10y CGB ~1.8%. ERP 6.5% (China mature-market ERP plus country premium), beta 1.0 -> 8.3%. Plus 2.0pp small-cap/illiquidity and 2.0pp structural premium for risks NOT modelled in the scenario flows: VIE/contractual-control enforceability over the PRC schools, central/provincial policy discretion over for-profit status and fee-setting, and the controlling family's demonstrated capacity to route group cash into related-party assets. Cost of equity ~12.3%. Debt is cheap (~3.5-4.75% secured bank loans) but deleveraging fast; at a target 85/15 equity/debt WACC ~ 11-11.5%, rounded UP to 12.0% because the structural premium is the one place those risks are charged. The same 12% is used in all three scenarios; demographic, margin, cash-tax and capex-leakage risk is charged in the scenario flows only (adaptations 7f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A) in principle, but immaterial: lease liabilities ~RMB1.3m (FY2025 AR 8001/8017) and lease cash ~RMB0.2-0.4m/yr. Not deducted from flows and not added to net debt (rounding).
inputs.nci_treatment: None. No non-controlling interests; profit for the year is wholly attributable to owners.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, three scenarios, per dcf-methods SKILL.md routing row 'Operating company, non-US' (private higher-education operator; tuition/boarding fee cash flows; not a bank/REIT/holdco). No prior DCF; first valuation. FY0 = FY2026E (year ended 31 Aug 2026; results not yet published at valuation date): revenue 1,919 = H1 FY2026 actual 956.3 + H2 estimated 963 (H2 FY2025 899.9 x 1.07, matching H1 growth of +7.4%). Year 1 of the projection is FY2027. Net debt is the 28-Feb-2026 interim balance (borrowings 1,239.1 less cash 218.9 less restricted deposits 232.2 that secure the bank facilities); H2 FY2026 (Mar-Aug 2026) flows are therefore omitted from both the bridge and the projection, a conservative omission of roughly RMB150-250m pre-Tianping-advance. EBITDA margin anchor: FY2025 profit from operations 909.9 + depreciation 278.9 - interest income 11.4 - Tianping interest 41.0 - Tianping consultancy 9.4 = 1,127 = 62.9% of revenue; Tianping income is stripped because it is accrued against related-party receivables (interest receivable from Tianping rose 58 -> 99 -> 127.5 with almost nothing collected) and its source asset is carried in the equity_bridge instead (adaptations 7d). Cash tax: FY2025 tax expense 11.4 on PBT 847 (1.3%), cash tax paid 0.1 - schools are effectively exempt today; every scenario ramps it because the for-profit/non-profit re-registration under the 2016 Decision is still unresolved ('no update' at 28-Feb-2026). TIANPING COLLEGE: total exposure RMB2,284.7m at 28-Feb-2026 = 800.1 sponsorship prepayment (paid by FY2022, transfer still not completed) + 1,252.1 unsecured advances at 4.75% due Aug-2026 + 127.5 accrued interest + 55.0 consultancy receivable + 50.0 security deposit. The chairman Mr Hou is a director of Tianping. Carried in the bridge at 30% recovery because conversion needs Ministry of Education sponsor-change approval with no date given, and repayment of RMB1.25bn from a single college's own cash flow is implausible on any short horizon. Advances continued at RMB316m in H1 FY2026; future advances are charged as extra capex in years 1-2 (base +5pp/+0pp, bear +10pp/+5pp) and given no value. MARKET SIGNAL: the share price fell from HK$4.3 (Dec 2025) to ~HK$1.3 (Mar 2026) on extreme volume (302m shares, ~25% of the register, in the week of 25-Jan-2026), and has drifted to <HK$1 since. The H1 FY2026 interim (approved 24-Apr-2026) discloses no event after the reporting period that explains it. At the current price the market cap is ~RMB1.0bn against FY2025 net profit of RMB836m (P/E ~1.2x), which is the market saying it does not believe reported earnings reach minority shareholders. This valuation cannot rule that out from the filings and charges it through a 45% bear weight and the 30% Tianping recovery rather than through the WACC.

equity_bridge.item: Tianping College exposure at 30% recovery (800.1 prepayment + 1,252.1 advance + 127.5 interest receivable + 55.0 consultancy receivable + 50.0 security deposit = 2,284.7 book)
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 AR note 18; H1 FY2026 interim note 12(iii) and related-party note (1969.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:1771-1774, 1837, 1748)

equity_bridge.item: Advances to third parties at 50% (book 153.9, unsecured, maturities extended to Feb-2027)
Offshore USD40m deposit securing an equivalent onshore RMB loan (in borrowings), at book
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 AR note 20(iv) line 10090; H1 FY2026 note 12(iv). Matching liability is inside total_debt, so the deposit offsets it 1:1.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 20.8% vs revenue 11.0% (diverges >30%). Equity growth is retained earnings that went largely into related-party Tianping receivables (+RMB1.5bn since FY2022), not into revenue-generating assets; revenue CAGR selected instead. 5yr EPS CAGR (41.5%) is off a FY2020 base depressed by the Tianping prepayment period and is not a forward guide.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC (net debt company: interest income not deducted; Tianping interest is accrued, not in OCF). Owner FCF 3yr CAGR -3.7% (FY2022 839.4 -> FY2025 748.8) vs revenue +11.0%: cash conversion has fallen as capex re-accelerated. Reported FCF also EXCLUDES related-party Tianping advances recorded in investing: net RMB346.9m FY2024, RMB213.4m FY2025, RMB316.0m H1 FY2026. 5yr FCF CAGR undefined (FY2020 owner FCF -531.9). SBC is immaterial (0.1-0.2% of revenue), so the SBC adjustment does not move the CAGRs.

base.growth_rationale: Enrolment +5.3% YoY at Feb-2026 and fees broadly flat-to-up give ~6% in FY2027, fading as quota growth slows; the 18-year-old cohort (2014-2016 births) peaks around 2032-2034 and then falls with the birth collapse, so growth turns negative in the back years and the terminal rate is 0%.
base.capex_rationale: Own-campus capex 20% (FY2025 25%, H1 FY2026 18%) plus 5pp in FY2027 for continued related-party Tianping advances, gliding to ~16% (just above 15.5% D&A) at no growth.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 core EBITDA 62.9% ex Tianping income; staff costs grew faster than tuition (gross margin 60.6% FY2021 -> 54.2% FY2025), so a slow 0.5pp/yr fade.

scenario_narratives.base: Chunlai keeps filling its Henan/Hubei dormitory capacity as quotas allow: enrolment grows mid-single digits for two to three years, then the demographic cliff in the college-age cohort (births halved 2016-2023) flattens and reverses it after FY2033. Staff costs keep outrunning tuition, fading core EBITDA margin from ~62% to 58%. Capex normalises to just above depreciation once the current dormitory build ends; Tianping advances taper after one more year and the existing RMB2.3bn exposure is worth 30 cents on the yuan. Schools are partially pulled into the tax net (10% cash rate) as for-profit re-registration is eventually forced. No re-rating: exit at 8x FCF with zero terminal growth.
scenario_narratives.bull: Henan quota increases and new dormitories lift enrolment high-single digits through FY2029, international/Sino-foreign programmes add a fee premium, and wage pressure eases so margins edge back to 64%. The schools stay effectively tax-exempt (5% cash rate). Capex settles at 16% without further related-party advances. Tianping conversion is NOT added to the flows (it would double-count the bridge); its upside sits only in the 30% recovery being conservative. Exit at 9x with 1% terminal growth.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2024 quota-shortfall signal spreads: private colleges in Henan/Hubei start competing on price as the cohort shrinks, enrolment falls 4-5% a year from FY2029, and fixed faculty and campus costs drive EBITDA margin down to 48%. Provinces apply the 25% enterprise tax on non-profit schools' tuition income. Cash keeps leaking into related-party projects (capex +10pp/+5pp in FY2027-28 for further Tianping advances). Exit at 5x with -2% terminal growth. The bridge still credits 30% of the Tianping book, so this scenario does NOT model outright loss of the RMB2.3bn; the 45% weight on it is how that risk is charged.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 45%: a 78% share-price collapse in Jan-Mar 2026 on ~25% of the register traded in one week, with no explaining disclosure, plus RMB2.3bn of related-party Tianping exposure with rolled maturities and uncollected interest, and a single-regulator dependency (MoE sponsor change, provincial quotas, for-profit status). Base 40%: the operating business itself (enrolment +5%, revenue +7%, finance costs halving) is still growing. Bull cut to 15%: it needs quotas, margins and tax status all to break favourably while the cohort is near its peak.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on Chunlai's own six campuses only, in CNY at a 12% CNY WACC that carries the structural VIE/policy/governance premium once; demographic, margin, tax and capex-leakage risk lives in the three scenario flows. The Tianping College exposure (RMB2.3bn, ~2.3x the market cap) is valued outside the flows at 30% recovery. Even the bear case is far above the price, which is not a buy signal by itself: the market is pricing a governance or cash-extraction event that the filings do not disclose, and the model cannot see it.
key_risks_to_valuation: Unexplained ~78% price collapse Jan-Mar 2026 on extreme volume (possible controlling-shareholder pledge enforcement or undisclosed governance issue); P/E ~1.2x implies the market discounts reported cash entirely
Related-party Tianping exposure RMB2,284.7m: sponsor change unapproved since 2019, advances unsecured, interest accrued not collected, chairman is a Tianping director
Opaque deposits/advances: USD40m offshore deposit backing an onshore third-party loan (due Jul-2026), RMB153.9m third-party advances with extended maturities
Demographic decline of the college-age cohort after ~2033 and early quota-fill failures across private HEIs
PRC policy: for-profit/non-profit re-registration, 25% tax on non-profit tuition income, quota and fee approvals, VIE enforceability
0.93m sqm of buildings without ownership certificates
